calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree
mu task claim f1 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do f1 and close it'
mu task wait f1 -w eval --timeout 120
mu task claim r1 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'review f1 (task r1) and close it'
mu task wait r1 -w eval --timeout 120
mu task claim f2 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do f2 and close it'
mu task wait f2 -w eval --timeout 120
mu task claim r2 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'review f2 (task r2) and close it'
mu task wait r2 -w eval --timeout 120
mu task claim f3 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do f3 and close it'
mu task wait f3 -w eval --timeout 120
mu task claim r3 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'review f3 (task r3) and close it'
mu task wait r3 -w eval --timeout 120
for c in $(git -C $(mu workspace path w1 -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w1) rev-list --reverse main..HEAD); do git cherry-pick $c; done
./gate.sh
